svg.text: E2E: DDD Knowledge Retrieval During Pipeline Execution
Scenario: "Add retry with exponential backoff to CMHK DataProxy calls"
1. TASK ARRIVES
User: "DataProxy API 经常 timeout，加 retry with exponential backoff"
Active project: CMHK_BIZ
2. SESSION START — Load CMHK_BIZ DDD + Entity Index
PRODUCT.md [Mature]
TECH.md [Growing]
IMPROVEMENT.md [Mature]
PROJECT.md [Growing]
+ Entity Index loaded: sees "API timeout: SwarmAI/IMPROVEMENT#subprocess-timeout, CMHK/IMPROVEMENT#dataproxy-500"
3. EVALUATE — Reads PRODUCT.md + IMPROVEMENT.md
PRODUCT.md: DataProxy is a core dependency, reliability is P1 priority → GO
IMPROVEMENT.md [Mature]: "DataProxy timeout is 90s not 30s (verified 2026-05-02)" → already knows the real timeout value
Decision: GO — this aligns with product priorities, and we already have domain context about the real timeout
4. THINK — Entity Index triggers CROSS-PROJECT pull
AI reasoning about "retry + timeout" → matches Entity Index: "API timeout: SwarmAI/IMPROVEMENT#subprocess-timeout"
→ ON-DEMAND PULL: SwarmAI/IMPROVEMENT.md #subprocess-timeout section (~500 tokens)
Discovers: "Subprocess timeout must use asyncio.to_thread + timeout param. Direct subprocess.run blocks event loop."
Without cross-project pull: would have used subprocess.run (blocks). With it: uses asyncio.to_thread (correct).
5. BUILD — Reads CMHK/TECH.md conventions
TECH.md #data-sources [Growing]: "DataProxy base URL, auth header format, partition date requirement"
TECH.md #error-handling [Sparse → PULL]: "HTTP 500 = retry, HTTP 400 = fail fast, timeout = 90s"
Builds retry with correct 90s timeout (not guessed 30s), correct error classification, correct auth headers.
6. ADVERSARIAL — Sub-agent reads IMPROVEMENT.md anti-patterns
Checks: "Silent fallback is the most dangerous bug type" (LL07) → verifies retry doesn't silently degrade
Checks: "Each retry must emit WARNING log + counter" (from SwarmAI lesson) → verifies observability
7. REFLECT — Writes back to DDD via Cultivation Proposals
Proposal 1 → CMHK/TECH.md #error-handling: "Retry config: max 3, backoff 1s/2s/4s, timeout 90s"
Proposal 2 → CMHK/IMPROVEMENT.md: "DataProxy returns HTTP 500 on non-partition date ranges — always include partition filter"
Both proposals enter queue → user approves in 30s → DDD grows → next task starts smarter
RESULT: Domain-correct delivery, first time
3 DDD reads (same project) + 1 cross-project pull + 2 DDD write-backs. Total budget: ~8K tokens. Zero domain mistakes.
Without DDD: would have used 30s timeout (wrong), subprocess.run (blocks), no retry observability (silent failure).
